market_summary: London session displays broad-based consolidation across major pairs, precious metals, and crypto. All five assets are currently trading inside their respective session Value Areas, tightly bound around session Points of Control (POCs) and VWAP/EMA baselines. Lacking yellow RVOL (>2.0) expansion spikes and with market participants awaiting the London-NY overlap, discipline dictates HOLD across the entire board to avoid low-liquidity churn.

signals.rationale: During LONDON_SESSION, price is trading inside the Value Area (VAL 3884.20 to VAH 3911.53) and hovering right at POC 3896.98 (signal close 3897.01 is above POC, live price 3895.03 is slightly below). Price sits below VWAP (3902.43) and below EMA50 (3900.73), exhibiting a bearish macro structure. CVD is -2.04 with a BEARISH label and flat slope (+0.14), agreeing with the broader down drift. However, price is mid-channel between lower ATR 3884.26 and upper ATR 3914.66 without directional momentum. Volume is subdued with RVOL at 0.689 lacking any yellow RVOL > 2.0 confirmation. Price is contained between S/R support 3887.45 and Session High 3922.99 with GEX null outside NY cash hours; holding inside VA at POC demands HOLD.
signals.level_event: rejection / below VWAP and consolidating above S/R 3887.45
